interpretationDecisions.decision: Source recipe marks powered Alon separately. The official introduction says connected Alon/Talim/SA1 can activate Bayani; powered Alon consumes it, while OD Alon and active Level 2 have distinct persistence. No stock quantity is invented.

The source prints neutral 6P. Preserve the exact prerequisite OD-Talim hit, visible blue-knife state and returning 22HP cover. Do not assign the pickup to a specific powered/boomerang effect or transplant it to an uncovered ordinary-Alon route.
Observed commands and boomerang cover, not an install/charge. Exact command-to-official-name mapping remains an inference; neutral labels used. No unsupported character-resource cost or gain claimed.
Remaining advantage after the action, not a wait count. Explicit delay throws use unquantified delays only.
Ordinary light-Alon standing-hit branches and explicitly blocked medium-Daloy branches are Pressure setups without an Oki tag. Wake-up branches require their exact knockdown.
Full-resolution input-history review identifies forward jump, heavy-kick glyph with back direction, then guard. Actual recorded opponent is Ryu OD Shoryuken; no universal safety claim.
Only the executed starter/strength/ender is authored. Alternative 22HP/SA1 finishers and two-button boomerang variations are not silently combined.

remainingGaps: Dedicated grounded anti-air and anti-projectile responses remain unextracted. The library does not imply coverage through tags.
The original Vesper footage still has substantial unprocessed heavy, jump-in, Level-2 and corner material.
Advanced two-button 22LPHP variations and the later +2F blocked-pressure family remain available for further extraction.
